scope: Exactly one manifest-selected current authoritative CPU project-main solver call. This wrapper never builds, invokes a reader, reruns an old control, installs a canonical executable, runs GenCase, manages Git, rearms the independent GPU component or launches a following job.
interface: -Configuration DebugCPU|ReleaseCPU -Window smoke|short_c|short_h|coarse|half -ExecutionAuthorized; full coarse/half additionally require -Admission PATH. The unique six-job manifest rejects unsupported pairs such as DebugCPU short_c.
program_source: Use only the passed tests/logs/upl_hg_column_DebugCPU_r1.build.json or ReleaseCPU_r1.build.json authoritative isolated program. Verify its actual typed project-call exit and exact argument vector. The project-call log is optional; b.log and b.binlog are bound separately.
manifest: Consume the successful tests/logs/upl_hg_column_r1.inputs.json, unique actual job tag and unique source variant. Bind all twelve fresh configuration/runtime/BI4/normal artifacts and the preparation's consumed inputs. Retain xi=.1, eta=.02, dyadic dt, unchanged event/loading and native22/1040 scope; the only comment correction is already owned by preparation.
gate_chain: DebugCPU smoke has no additional column-native predecessor; its current authoritative build and successful prepared manifest are required.
ReleaseCPU smoke requires upl_hg_column_DebugCPU_smoke_r1.native.json passed and bound to that exact passed .run.json.
ReleaseCPU short_c requires ReleaseCPU smoke native passed; short_h requires short_c native passed.

Full .5s coarse and half each require both passed short native owners plus a separate root-authored short-physical-review admission. Required schema: stage upl_hg_column_admission_r1, passed true, allowed_jobs containing this exact job tag, physical_acceptance false, and nonempty immutable inputs bindings. This wrapper does not create or infer an admission.
native_prerequisite_schema: The preceding <jobtag>.native.json must have passed true, physical_acceptance false and source_run Entry matching the exact <jobtag>.run.json. The passed prior run must identify the expected job tag and unchanged bindings; its actual typed exit0, program, Run.out and source-build identities are verified. Optional reader_call and completion entries, when present, are verified too.
ownership: Require fresh output/run/call/start/log paths. Reject a currently running actual DualSPHysics CPU executable; permit the separately owned frozen GPU component. Save owner PID and process creation UTC, exact program/argv, manifest/build/job and admission in a fresh start receipt before the direct native call. Capture the original integer LASTEXITCODE immediately and seal the owned call receipt before reading Run.out or inspecting PART files. Failed postchecks retain the original exit and outputs and never retry the solver.
bound_before_and_after: Current 265 code/header source membership and each current/snapshot hash, source/readme/XML-guide snapshots, current86 objects and compile sources, actual tools/libraries, compiler/linker tlogs, four current/isolated runtime pairs, seven canonical programs, prepared inputs and all consumed prerequisite/admission identities. Current source must stay stable until the owned call and final verification finish.
postchecks: Actual CPU8 normal code0 finish, exact total steps, zero exclusions, configured xi=.1/eta=.02/SPR=None, forcecalls and logical ratecalls=2N, predictor/corrector updates=N, actual ratecalculations=N+1, endpoint reuses=N-1. Require the single-J M0*Href and mi*deltaAce diagnostic labels, finite nonnegative diagnostics, max(dt/tau)<=.2 and cumulative spin<.01. Require exact contiguous raw PART membership of3,458 or1469 frames. No native field or clock is fabricated or inferred from these log checks.
native_owner_handoff: Run record stage upl_hg_column_run_r1 supplies passed, backend CPU, configuration, window, tag, exact manifest job, input_manifest Entry, source_build Entry, program Entry, call Entry, actual Run.out Entry in run_out, inputs Entry[], recursive completed-output files Entry[], output_directory, bindings_unchanged and source_bindings_unchanged. The owned call has identical program/target_program and arguments/target_arguments, direct_native_call, typed_LASTEXITCODE_captured_immediately, owned_call_exited, original integer exit_code, invocation_failure and actual captured log Entry. Pure native review is a separate root-owned action.
limitations: This owner proves an actual completed solver call and original operational HG gates only. All22 native fields, actual binary clocks, single-J ledgers, drainage masks, short/full prefix checks, independent half-step behavior, column/layer spread, mode projection and physical acceptance remain separate. HGON is not expected to be bit-identical to retained HGOFF.
